ALREADY HAVE A HOST?

Open your Aterus.

THREE STEPS TO YOUR OWN CONNECTION

From your desk
to wherever you work.

01 / DESKTOP HOST

Run it on your computer.

On Apple Silicon Mac, extract and open Aterus.app, then choose a workspace. Source users can run Setup-Mac.command. On Windows, install Python 3.10+, run Setup-Windows.ps1 under your normal script policy, then Start-Aterus.cmd. Use native agent executables.

02 / PRIVATE CONNECTION

Pair your devices.

In Devices, select Enable phone access. Scan the QR, compare the verification code and approve the phone on your computer. The temporary HTTPS URL changes after restart. Your own agent accounts stay on your host.

03 / INSTALL THE PWA

Keep it close.

On iPhone, open your host in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen. Android and desktop Chrome/Edge offer Install when eligible. Keep the computer awake and online.

What this build does.

Agent terminals

Direct terminals for installed coding agents, with live output, keyboard input, safe stopping and saved records. Claude and OpenCode exchanges were confirmed by the developer's local tests.

Live OpenCode attachment

Connect a second frontend to an already-running owned OpenCode server and exact native session. Detaching leaves the external server running. An attach-capable server is required.

Other external terminals

Optional read-only Terminal.app history on Mac, with owner/workspace/process checks. Generic control of arbitrary pre-existing terminals is not implemented.

Honest limits

Physical phone installation and Windows execution still need testing. Windows files are disabled pending safe path handling. Background push, a stable managed relay and signed automatic desktop updates are not included. Temporary HTTPS setup requires an explicit click.

A public download.
A private workspace.

Everyone can download the software. Each user supplies their own computer, agent accounts, HTTPS connection and pairing. This page is a distribution and connection guide—not a shared server for your private coding sessions.
